cards.scene: 日常活动 · Daily Routine · 续2
cards.example_en: I understand the diagram once the teacher adds labels.
cards.example_zh: 老师加上标注之后，我就理解了这张图。

cards.scene: 日常活动 · Daily Routine · 续2
cards.example_en: The factory will undertake the repair of the school roof.
cards.example_zh: 这家工厂将承担学校屋顶的修理工作。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：吃惊的
cards.example_en: I was amazed when the quiet boy won the singing prize.
cards.example_zh: 那个安静的男孩赢得歌唱奖时，我非常吃惊。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：令人沮丧的
cards.example_en: Waiting for the bus is frustrating.
Remote learning continued while the roads were blocked by snow.
cards.example_zh: 道路被雪堵住时，远程学习仍在继续。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：不正常的
cards.example_en: A temperature of forty degrees is abnormal and needs a doctor.
cards.example_zh: 四十度的体温不正常，需要去看医生。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：偶尔的
cards.example_en: An occasional bus runs to the village after dusk.
cards.example_zh: 黄昏后，偶尔有一班公交车开往那个村子。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：至关重要的

cards.example_en: Tomatoes are ripening in the garden beside the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 西红柿正在厨房旁边的花园里渐渐成熟。

cards.example_en: The author signed my book at the school fair.
cards.example_zh: 作者在学校义卖会上给我的书签了名。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：烘焙师
cards.example_en: The baker saved us two warm loaves before closing.
cards.example_zh: 面包师关门前给我们留了两条热面包。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：清洁工

cards.example_en: Don't touch the cooker, it's hot.
cards.example_zh: 请勿触摸炊具，因为它很烫。

cards.example_en: The keys are in the drawer.
Ice cream stays hard in the freezer beside the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 冰淇淋在冰箱旁边的冰柜里还是硬的。
